name: Daniel Luis Nanton Barral
headline: Senior Project Manager · Change Management Lead
summary: Results-driven Senior Project Manager and Change Management Lead with over 25 years of experience directing enterprise IT transformations, core banking migrations, and cross-border regulatory reporting projects across Latin America. Proven track record in multi-country stakeholder management, operational risk reduction, financial reporting optimization, and enterprise Artificial Intelligence (AI) process automation. Seeking a Senior Project Manager, Change Management Lead, or Transformation Manager role offering remote work or international relocation (Canada / Europe).
skills: **Project management and strategy:** Enterprise change management, end-to-end core banking migrations, regulatory reporting compliance, cross-border stakeholder management, Agile, Scrum, Kanban, PMO leadership, vendor negotiation, operational risk reduction.
**Artificial intelligence and emerging tech:** Enterprise AI champion, generative AI process automation, machine learning integration, full-stack web development architecture.

**Data analytics and software tools:** Python, SQL, Google BigQuery, Tableau, Power Query, Microsoft Project, advanced Google Sheets, Firebase, Vercel, GitHub, Antigravity, Oracle Siebel CRM, IBM DB2.

experience.role: Transformation & Change Management Lead / Senior Project Manager
bullets: **LATAM end-to-end regulatory reporting migration:** Lead change management and project management strategy for a multi-year financial transformation migrating end-to-end regulatory reporting platforms across 6 Latin American countries within a 3-year timeline.

**Artificial intelligence (AI) champion:** Design and implement AI-driven process automation tools across business reporting units, eliminating manual entry risks and decreasing human error in complex financial calculations.

**Brazil core general ledger migration:** Spearheaded change management and PM streams migrating Brazil's core general ledger from a legacy 40-year-old localized system to a standardized global corporate core platform.

experience.org: BAC Credomatic · San José, Costa Rica
bullets: Directed cross-functional technology and operations teams across 6 countries, driving digital transformation, core banking data integration, and regional project management.

**Regional CRM and CX transformation (2004–2010):** Established a multi-country unit to deploy Oracle Siebel CRM across 6 countries; extracted legacy core banking data (IBM DB2, IBS Core) for executive dashboards; negotiated $6M+ in technology vendor contracts using Six Sigma methodologies.

**IT operations and data warehouse (2000–2004):** Managed IT infrastructure ($1M budget, 15 specialists) supporting branch network and online banking; achieved ISO-9001 certification within 6 months. Founded the corporate Data Warehouse department to automate multi-country profitability analytics.

Architected and built an AI-powered local investment analysis web platform for Costa Rican Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) using modern cloud infrastructure (Antigravity IDE, Firebase, GitHub, Vercel).

Founded and managed heavy equipment rental operations, reducing operating expenses by 60% through process optimization and strategic partnerships. Successfully negotiated and executed the sale of the business in January 2025.
